figure: start: figure 2 of method/README.md, the half-plane phi = 0 of HSX at true scale

example.what: HSX, the Helically Symmetric eXperiment: 48 modular coils, 4 field periods (simsopt 1.11's coil set). The file carries no surface, so torux starts from the magnetic axis

request.what: the request of examples/any_source.py, run with torux 0.1.3

lettered.what: the numbers lettered in the figure: the flux of the heavy curve, the radius of the dashed circle and the factor of the inset

Psi0_Wb.what: the flux asked for, and s = sqrt(Psi) there, to which the s of every ring is referred

answer.what: the surface asked for, refined and verified: the heavy curve. refinement is (M, N, off-grid |B.n|/|B|) from the continuation's torus to the refined one (torux.family.refine_to_limit). bn_off_solver is the largest |B.n|/|B| on the grid shifted half a cell, bn_max_independent the same at 4,096 random points by torux.reference (torux.verify.verify_torus)

axis.what: the magnetic axis where it crosses phi = 0 (the dot). R0 is the axis's mean major radius, the constant term of its R series, the R0 of the start circle's 0.004 R0. iota and Greene's residue from its monodromy
axis.from: torux.analysis.find_axes, the axis passed to torux.family.Continuation.start

start_circle.what: the circle the solver begins from (dashed, in the inset): torux.family.axis_torus_start with eps = 0.004 R0, and the flux it encloses, at which the first surface is solved

first_surface.what: the torus Newton's method made of the circle at its flux (the ellipse in the inset): height and width of its section at phi = 0 and their ratio

family.what: every torus the continuation accepted, the start first, at s = sqrt(Psi): the thin rings, the last of them, at the request, drawn as the refined surface. The step in s starts at 0.05 of the request's s, grows 1.5 times per accepted step up to 0.2, halves on a failure, and the last is cut to end at the request. resonances_crossed: the rational iota = n N_fp / m, m <= 30, that lie between two consecutive tori (between: their indices), each crossed by an accepted step with no failure, so no chain stopped the continuation and none was jumped

inset.what: the inset is the region of the dot outlined in the main drawing (width and height in R and Z), magnified this many times, line weights unchanged

check.what: the drawn sections measured by torux.reference, which shares no code with the solver: the flux each encloses (minus the loop integral of A along it) against the torus's own, and field lines started on each, traced one turn, against the section, at every field period
